Workspaces and files shared with you will appear here.
On a computer, open KyDrive and go to Settings, Phones & apps, Link a phone. Then scan the code it shows.
%1$s signed this phone out. Show a new code on a computer and scan it to link again.
This links the phone to %1$s. Continue only if you opened Link a phone on that server yourself.
That is not a KyDrive link code.
That code was already used or has expired. Show a new one and scan it again.
This phone holds another account\'s files. Unlink it in Settings before linking a different account or server.
KyDrive refused to link this phone (error %1$d).
Could not reach %1$s. Check the connection and try again.
This phone does not trust %1$s\'s certificate.
This phone was unlinked from KyDrive, and everything it held has been erased.
This removes the phone from %1$s and erases everything KyDrive keeps on it.
This phone is unlinked, but %1$s could not be reached. Remove it under Settings, Phones & apps on a computer too.
